watch.firstLine: You can't send what refuses to go.

lines: You can't send what refuses to go.
Spira's sorrow is patient, Lady Yuna.
...I couldn't.
We keep climbing.
That's it? We just walk past them?
Yuna. The thing Seymour said.
It's true.
...Which thing.
I've known since Zanarkand.
...I'm sorry.
The people of Zanarkand. All of them.
Still dreaming.
You know what we dream about.
A city. A sea. A boy who plays blitzball.
...Say it straight.
You are a dream.
We climbed the rest of the way in the dark.
Nobody talked.
I kept counting the ones we left behind.
Then I stopped counting.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Kimahri knows this one. And this one.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: They held the gate. All of them.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Late, Ronso. They called your name.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: You were on the wrong side of the mountain.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: They refused comfort. I offered it anyway.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: That's not comfort. That's a pile of bodies.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: You talk about him when you think no one listens.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: So let me give you what no one else will.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Kill Sin, and you free him.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: I am offering you your father back.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: You don't get to hand me a reason.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: He's not a bargaining chip. He's my old man.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: He talks to keep you standing still.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Spira is a wound that will not close.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: It's quieter on the other side.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Lady Yuna. You need not suffer.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: No. I will walk it to the end.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: It makes the rest feel earned.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: You can't send what refuses to go.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Spira's sorrow is patient, Lady Yuna.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Hey. That's not on you, ya?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: That's it? We just walk past them?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Don't. You're the one who has to swing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: The people of Zanarkand. All of them.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Fayth Boy
dboxTimeline.text: You know what we dream about.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Fayth Boy
dboxTimeline.text: A city. A sea. A boy who plays blitzball.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Fayth Boy
dboxTimeline.text: Your father was a dream. Zanarkand is a dream.
We climbed the rest of the way in the dark.
I kept counting the ones we left behind.
